issues.problem: made-until contrast vs に listed 送る among verbs where に sounds odd, but 実家に荷物を送る is standard.
issues.action: Removed 送る from the list.

issues.problem: made-until mistake '最後に読みました' is a grammatical sentence (I read it last), not an error.
issues.action: Replaced with 駅に歩きました -> 駅まで歩きました, noting that 行く takes に normally.

issues.problem: madeni-deadline example English 'Please have this book read by tomorrow' was awkward.
issues.action: Changed to 'Please finish reading this book by tomorrow.'

issues.problem: yori-comparison explain called the より item 'the thing that loses or is beaten', false for e.g. 東京は大阪より小さい; the ほう sentence was confusing.
issues.action: Reworded to 'the thing the other side is measured against'; clarified that the AはBより frame needs no ほう.

issues.problem: yori-comparison mistake '大阪は東京より大きいです' is grammatical, only factually different; yori-formal-from contrast vs に overstated より as 'the standard choice' in notices.
issues.action: Deleted that mistake entry (2 remain); rewrote the contrast note to describe より as framing the start of a period, formal use only.
